user_query.query_text: Reconstruct preparation and recovery during the fictional Baytown storm of 1-2 January 2025.

samples.content: On 1 January 2025, Baytown Council warned residents about a storm. The council and Baytown Rescue opened a shelter together. Forty residents arrived at the shelter.
On 2 January 2025, Baytown Council inspected the roads with Baytown Rescue. The main road reopened at noon. The shelter closed that evening after all forty residents returned home.
